content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Coconut Development Board has issued its recruitment notification dated 6 November 2026 for 35 vacancies, as published in Employment News dated 21–27 November 2026. The notification contains vacancy details, post-specific qualifications and experience, pay levels, age restrictions, application fee information and online application instructions. Official Recruitment Page: Coconut Development Board Vacancy Notifications Candidates should download the official notification through the Board's website before applying.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Vacancy 2026 - 35 Posts
content_sections.text: The Coconut Development Board has announced 35 vacancies across 13 categories . The recruitment covers Group A, Group B and Group C positions, offering opportunities for candidates with different educational and professional qualifications. Lower Division Clerk has the highest vacancy count with 13 posts , followed by Field Officer with 5 posts and Deputy Director (Development) with 4 posts . Candidates should select posts according to their qualifications and experience rather than vacancy numbers alone.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications and experience requirements vary depending on the post. Some positions require only Class 12 with specific additional qualifications, while others require graduation, postgraduate degrees and relevant professional experience. Important: These are summaries of the educational and experience requirements. Candidates applying for senior posts must verify the complete alternative experience requirements, pay-level conditions and accepted qualifications in the official recruitment notice. Yes. Class 12 pass candidates can apply for Lower Division Clerk posts if they possess the prescribed computer typing speed. Class 12 Science candidates may also apply for Field Officer positions if they have the required Agriculture or Horticulture Diploma or Certificate. For the 13 Lower Division Clerk vacancies , candidates must have passed Class 12 from a recognized board. They must also possess one of the following computer typing speeds: English typing: 35 words per minute. Hindi typing: 30 words per minute. The typing requirement corresponds to the prescribed computer-based key-depression standard in the recruitment notice. Candidates applying for the 5 Field Officer vacancies must have passed Class 12 or Intermediate with Science. They must also possess a recognized Diploma or Certificate in Agriculture or Horticulture. The Data Entry Operator position requires graduation from a recognized university. Applicants must also pass the prescribed data-entry skill requirement of 15,000 key depressions per hour on a computer . Yes. Candidates holding a relevant Agriculture or Horticulture degree can apply for suitable positions, including Development Officer, if they meet the prescribed experience requirements. Postgraduate candidates may also qualify for Assistant Director or Deputy Director positions, subject to the specified academic and professional experience conditions.

rows.educational_qualification_and_experience: Master's Degree in Horticulture, Agriculture or Plant Sciences with prescribed experience in agricultural or horticultural development, including the qualifying Government/pay-level experience route.
Master's Degree in Horticulture, Agriculture or Plant Sciences with the prescribed experience in agricultural or horticultural development.
Master's Degree from a recognized university with five years of prescribed experience in administration and establishment matters.
Associate qualification of ICAI/ICMAI or the prescribed Commerce postgraduate and intermediate professional qualification route, with applicable experience.
Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture or Horticulture with two years of experience in agricultural or horticultural development activities.
B.Tech. in Food Processing or Food Technology, or Master's Degree in Food and Nutrition or an equivalent recognized qualification, with two years of food-processing experience.
Bachelor's Degree in Arts, Science or Commerce with three years of experience in a Government office, autonomous body or statutory organization.
Master's Degree in Commerce or prescribed intermediate professional accountancy qualification, with five years of relevant audit and accounts experience.
Master's Degree in Hindi with English studied as prescribed, along with the specified translation diploma or accepted translation experience route.
Graduation with shorthand speed of 120 words per minute and typing speed of 45 words per minute.
Intermediate/Class 12 with Science and Diploma or Certificate in Agriculture or Horticulture from a recognized institution.
Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university with computer data-entry speed of 15,000 key depressions per hour.
Class 12 pass with prescribed typing speed of 35 WPM in English or 30 WPM in Hindi on a computer.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive salaries according to the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix . The advertised positions carry Pay Levels 2, 4, 6, 7, 10 and 11. Salary Clarification: These are basic pay scales. Actual monthly salaries may include Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance and other applicable Government benefits, subject to deductions and service rules.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification prescribes an application fee of Rs. 300 for candidates who are not exempted. Payment Mode: SBI Collect.

content_sections.heading: Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Coconut Development Board will conduct selection according to the requirements of the advertised posts and its recruitment rules. The process may include the following stages, as applicable: Online application submission. Scrutiny of eligibility and supporting documents. Written examination, where notified. Skill, shorthand, typing or computer proficiency test for applicable positions. Interview, where applicable. Original document verification. Final selection and appointment according to merit and applicable rules. Candidates applying for Lower Division Clerk posts must possess the prescribed computer typing speed of 35 WPM in English or 30 WPM in Hindi . Stenographer Grade II applicants must possess shorthand proficiency of 120 WPM and typing speed of 45 WPM , as prescribed in the recruitment notice. Data Entry Operator candidates must possess a computer data-entry speed of 15,000 key depressions per hour .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Coconut Development Board has announced 35 vacancies across 13 Group A, B and C post categories.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The reference schedule lists 21 December 2026. The original notice requires applications within 30 days of Employment News publication, so candidates should confirm the official portal deadline.

faq.question: Q3. When does Coconut Development Board online registration start?
faq.answer: The reference recruitment schedule lists 21 November 2026 as the online application starting date.

faq.question: Q4. How many LDC vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 13 Lower Division Clerk vacancies under Group C, Pay Level 2.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Coconut Development Board LDC?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12 and possess English typing speed of 35 WPM or Hindi typing speed of 30 WPM on a computer.

faq.question: Q6. Can 12th pass candidates apply for Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Class 12 pass candidates can apply for eligible LDC posts, while Field Officer posts additionally require Science and a recognized Agriculture or Horticulture Diploma/Certificate.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 27, 30, 35 or 40 years depending on the post, before applicable relaxation.

faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 300. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt.
